regime.label: Dealer long gamma reaches +11,678 with the future 1.8 points above a 1081.5 flip: a damping 1080-1100 corridor above a short-gamma trapdoor
evidence: +11,678 total net GEX is 4.2x the +2,762 of 02 Sep, and the 1080 ATM strike alone carries +3,468 - dealers now fade moves inside the corridor rather than chase them.
1081.5 is the interpolated cumulative-GEX zero-crossing (cum -432 at 1080, +2,432 at 1090) and the future closed at 1083.3 - only 1.8 points of long-gamma cushion.

7,228 call OI sits in the 1080/1090/1100 band versus 2,740 put OI - the burden above spot is a call block, and 1100 took 208 lots of volume today with price 16.7 points away, so it is a live wall, not stale OI.
12.56% ATM IV is the 7-session low (14.09% on 03 Sep) and the 1-sigma day is 8.57 points - the structure itself is compressing the realised range.

S50U26.today_summary: 1083.3 on the Sep future, +3.9, the sixth advance in seven sessions and 13.3 points above the 1070 max pain. 2.26 P/C OI and 1.89 P/C volume look bearish on their face, but the 16,321-lot 910 put wall behind that ratio traded 61 lots and carries zero gamma - it is parked insurance, not a live burden. The active structure is the 2,795-lot 1100 call wall above and the 2,036-lot 1050 put wall below, with dealers long +11,678 gamma between them. 550 new puts printed at 1000 on 613 lots today - a cheap 20.84%-IV tail hedge bought well away from spot, not a directional short.
what_changed: Net dealer gamma rose to +11,678 from +10,068 yesterday and +2,762 on 02 Sep - a 4.2x five-session build that converts dealer hedging from trend-amplifying to mean-reverting.
The gamma flip migrated down to 1081.5 from 1099.6 on 02 Sep, a 18-point drop that tracked spot up and left only 1.8 points between the future and short-gamma territory.
25-delta skew flattened to +0.87 from +2.90 on 02 Sep, dipping to -0.39 on 05 Sep - downside protection is being sold back as the market rallies, the opposite of a fear bid.
Put OI grew +2,168 to 43,797 while call OI added only +551 to 19,349, but the growth clustered at 1000 (+794) and 1050 (+156) - accumulation below the market, so this is a build, not an unwind.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: The future has covered +18.9 points since 02 Sep (1064.4 to 1083.3, +1.78%) while max pain drifted only +10 to 1070, leaving spot 13.3 points above the anchor. That gap would normally flag max-pain failure, but the confirming tell is missing: ATM IV compressed 1.36 points to 12.56% and the 1-sigma day shrank from 9.34 to 8.57 points, so this is an orderly drift, not a vol-expansion breakout beating the option structure. The decisive change is the gamma flip falling 18 points to 1081.5 while total GEX quadrupled - the market has climbed into its own damping field, and the 1100 call wall has not moved in seven sessions despite +48 OI. Put OI still grows faster than call OI (+2,168 vs +551 over five sessions), but it accumulates at 1000 and 1050, far from spot, so the 2.26 P/C reads as insurance stacked beneath a rally rather than positioning against it. The asymmetry to respect: above 1081.5 dealers fade every push toward 1100, below it they sell into weakness, and there is no meaningful OI shelf between 1050 and 1080 to break the fall.

strategies.name: Iron condor 1030P / 1050P x 1100C / 1120C
strategies.rationale: Both short strikes sit on live walls - 1050 put (2,036 OI, 417 lots today) and 1100 call (2,795 OI, 208 lots today) - and dealers hold +11,678 gamma between them, so hedging flow works against any push out of the corridor while 12.56% IV is the 7-session low.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20-point wing width minus roughly 5.4 points of net credit (1.8 put side + 3.6 call side) = about 14.6 points on the breached side.
strategies.invalidation: A close beyond 1100 or below 1050; the earlier warning is a close below the 1081.5 gamma flip, which turns dealers short gamma and removes the damping the structure depends on.

strategies.name: Bull put spread 1040 / 1060
strategies.rationale: Sells 1060 into a 25-delta skew that has flattened to +0.87 from +2.90 while spot holds 13.3 points above the 1070 max pain and above the 1081.5 flip, where dealer long gamma cushions pullbacks.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20-point width minus about 2.6 points of net credit (1060P 5.4 bid, 1040P 2.8 ask) = about 17.4 points; the negative-skew payoff means small frequent gains against a rare large loss.
strategies.invalidation: A close below 1081.5 flips dealers short gamma; a close below the 1050 put wall opens the 1050-to-1000 air pocket where no OI shelf exists.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1040 / 1070
strategies.rationale: The trapdoor hedge: only 1.8 points separate 1083.3 from the 1081.5 flip, and below it dealers sell into weakness toward 1050, while 12.56% ATM IV at a 7-session low makes the protection cheap in absolute terms.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = the net debit of about 5.6 points (1070P 8.2 ask, 1040P 2.6 bid), against a 30-point width, so about 24.4 points of maximum payoff.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above 1090 with the flip holding below spot restores the long-gamma pin and bleeds the position to theta with 20 days left.

S50U26.prediction: 1080 to 1100 is the base case corridor for the next several sessions: dealers hold +11,678 gamma above the 1081.5 flip, the 1100 call wall has been fixed for seven sessions, and an 8.57-point 1-sigma day means one standard deviation barely reaches it. The bias tilts mildly higher inside that band while spot stays above 1081.5, since 12.56% IV and drained skew give sellers no urgency. A close below 1081.5 invalidates the whole framing - dealers flip to short gamma, hedging turns pro-cyclical, and 1050 becomes the next OI shelf with nothing between.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and nothing here recommends executing a trade. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index, so there is no physical delivery to force closing flow into a strike: pinning is a tendency here, structurally weaker than for share-settled single stocks, and the 1070 max pain is an anchor rather than a target - spot has already held 13.3 points above it for four sessions. The 910 put wall's 16,321 lots are stale insurance (61 lots traded, zero gamma) and should not be read as support. Defined risk is not low risk: the short-vol structures above carry a real maximum loss of 14.6 to 17.4 points, and a gap through the 1081.5 flip would realise it faster than the long-gamma regime implies.
